description: Founded and built ZipMath, a mobile app that teaches mental-math shortcuts through short lessons and game-style practice, with 26 levels across Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced tiers.
highlights: Designed the engagement system: XP, daily streaks, 3 hearts per practice round, and a 1 to 3 star rating (no mistakes earns 3 stars), to keep learners practicing.

Built the app in React Native and TypeScript with a question engine that computes every answer in code, so practice questions are always correct, and animated lesson and quiz flows that save progress on the device.

organization: Apache Kafka, Kubernetes Java Client, PostgreSQL JDBC
description: Merged 3 documentation pull requests into major open source projects, each through the project's review process: Apache Kafka, Kubernetes Java client, and PostgreSQL JDBC.
highlights: Rewrote the Kafka Streams guide and the Javadoc of two core classes (3 files, 43 lines) to explain that enabling topology optimizations takes two steps, with a code example and a warning that build() without Properties silently skips them.

Wrote 147 lines of release history (v15.0.0 to v25.0.0, including the v20.0.0 breaking changes) for the Kubernetes client, and documented the SCRAM authentication test setup for the PostgreSQL JDBC driver.
